title: WAMCast: Neural-Operator WAM-IPE Surrogate for Thermospheric Mass-Density Forecasting
description: Inference-only Python package for the WAMCast surrogate model of WAM-IPE thermospheric mass density. Includes the T=16 SFNO backbone, 20-member ensemble rollout, and split-conformal calibration used in Hu & McCrossan (2026, JGR:MLC).

creators.name: Hu, Andong
creators.affiliation: Space Weather Technology, Research and Education Center (SWx-TREC), University of Colorado Boulder
